name: Greater Thermal Shock · Earth
primary:
A widening stream (up to 3 blocks wide) hits everyone in front of you; in instant mode it keeps going while held:
• Damage 4.5 ❤ fire + 3 ❤ earth (fire ×0.5 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Heat: sets on fire for 21.6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Cold 144: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• If the target is frozen or brittle: damage 17 ❤ thermal
• Brittle (earth damage ×2) for 9 s
